svg.aria-label: Paired horizontal bars per GPU in plain run 883b7a: percent of the weights held, then of GPU energy. Z13 Radeon 8060S, GPU rail only: 41.0 and 1.6. The rig's seven 8 GB NVIDIA cards hold 2.3 each and draw 3070 FE 6.8, 3060 Ti ZOTAC 7.2, GTX 1080 7.8, GTX 1070 6.8, 3060 Ti EVGA 9.0, RTX 2080 7.1 and 3070 ASUS 7.8; together 16.4 and 52.6. Rig AMD: RX 5700 XT 3.1 and 3.6; RX 6600s at blocks 25 to 26, 28 and 29: 3.3 and 1.3; 3.1 and 1.5; 2.3 and 1.1. On gamingrig, at high clocks: 2080 Ti 3.1 and 10.8; 4090 8.7 and 10.3. GPURIG's A6000: 19.3 and 17.2. Below, 565 W while generating: deep-idle floor 260 W, 46 percent; awake premium 261 W, 46 percent; work 44 W, 8 percent. Awake with nothing to do: 521 W, 92 percent. Power samples read 2.5 percent above the meters' 551 W.
